history.origins: Jordan and Palestine. Children's game related to Crazy Eights: no wild suit card; Aces force another player to give the active player a King ('checkmate'). Red and black Jokers match any card of their colour.
timeline: Middle East; related to Crazy Eights
Ace = receive a King from another player

setup.players: 2, 3, or 4 players. Play anticlockwise. If dealer wins, deal passes right; otherwise same player deals again.
setup.deck: 52 cards plus 2 Jokers (one red, one black). 54 cards total.
setup.dealing: 10 cards each, one at a time. Rest form face-down stock (fanned; any card may be drawn). Dealer leads first card to start play pile.

rules.objective: Be the first to run out of cards. Play a card matching the top card in rank or suit; Jokers match any card of their colour (red/black).
rules.gameplay: Each turn: if possible play one card (same rank or suit as top of play pile). If not, draw one from stock; if it matches, play it; else add to hand. Ace: when played, another player gives you a King.
keyRules: Match top card by rank or suit
Red Joker matches any red card; black Joker any black
Ace: receive a King from another player
